MalthaelOnAPaleHorse.name: On a Pale Horse
MalthaelOnAPaleHorse.description: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

MalthaelFearTheReaper.name: Fear the Reaper
MalthaelFearTheReaper.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

MalthaelDieAlone.name: Die Alone
MalthaelDieAlone.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

MalthaelThrowingShade.name: Throwing Shade
MalthaelThrowingShade.description: Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30. Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

MalthaelBlackHarvest.name: Black Harvest
MalthaelBlackHarvest.description: Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 180 seconds. Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

MalthaelColdHand.name: Cold Hand
MalthaelColdHand.description: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

MalthaelMassacre.name: Massacre
MalthaelMassacre.description: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

MalthaelTouchOfDeath.name: Touch of Death
MalthaelTouchOfDeath.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

MalthaelTormentedSouls.name: Tormented Souls
MalthaelTormentedSouls.description: Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds. When Tormented Souls is cast and when it expires, reset the cooldown of Wraith Strike.

MalthaelLastRites.name: Last Rites
MalthaelLastRites.description: Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health. Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of

MalthaelSoulSiphon.name: Soul Siphon
MalthaelSoulSiphon.description: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

MalthaelEtherealExistence.name: Ethereal Existence
MalthaelEtherealExistence.description: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

MalthaelInevitableEnd.name: Inevitable End
MalthaelInevitableEnd.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

MalthaelShroudOfWisdom.name: Shroud of Wisdom
MalthaelShroudOfWisdom.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

MalthaelSoulCollector.name: Soul Collector
MalthaelSoulCollector.description: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

MalthaelMortality.name: Mortality
MalthaelMortality.description: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

MalthaelMementoMori.name: Memento Mori
MalthaelMementoMori.description: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

MalthaelReaperOfSouls.name: Reaper of Souls
MalthaelReaperOfSouls.description: Increase Tormented Souls' duration by 2 seconds. While Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh the duration.

MalthaelAngelOfDeath.name: Angel of Death
MalthaelAngelOfDeath.description: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

MalthaelFinalCurtain.name: Final Curtain
MalthaelFinalCurtain.description: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

MalthaelNoOneCanStopDeath.name: No One Can Stop Death
MalthaelNoOneCanStopDeath.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.
